item.title: Inconsistency when chat is open in editor tab

labels.name: info-needed
labels.description: Issue requires more information from poster

item.body:
Type: Bug After opening a chat session with Copilot modifications outstanding in an editor tab, then trying to close it, a dialog will appear. It will prompt for saving current changes or cancelling the closing. When selecting cancelation, the editor will remain opened, but the sidebar chat will open the same session, effectively duplicating it. Extension version: 0.27.3 VS Code version: Code 1.100.3 (258e40fedc6cb8edf399a463ce3a9d32e7e1f6f3, 2025-06-02T13:30:54.273Z) OS version: Linux x64 6.11.0-26-generic snap Modes:
